# Lancer Light UI

These files are the browser rendering sources from
[raylee-ai/lancer v1.0.1, packages/light-ui](https://github.com/raylee-ai/lancer/tree/v1.0.1/packages/light-ui).
Only the relative TypeScript import suffixes were adapted for Turbopack. No
Electron, Lancer workspace code, screenshots, model service, or CLI runtime is included.
